title: Signature 47 · USSBBW · Son Mai · Cream Studio
prompt:
Subject: ONE Black woman in her early 40s, long glossy black waves.

Physique: THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH, blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, not brown, her face the same deep tone with natural highlights and clearly defined features, not flat. USSBBW physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits, around 800 pounds — an enormous soft apron belly hanging in several heavy overlapping rolls down to mid-thigh, deep creases between each roll, not pregnant, a gigantic bust resting on the belly, no waist at all, deep side rolls, hips wider than a normal woman's whole torso, huge thighs pressed together, enormous soft upper arms, dominating the frame.

Body Art: Full body Vietnamese son mai lacquer painted directly on bare skin, covering every inch from neck to ankle without exception. Glossy black and cinnabar-red lacquer with gold-leaf lotus vines and dense crushed white eggshell mosaic of tiny white fragments, not kintsugi. The lotus vines and eggshell mosaic cover the whole body, a line of white eggshell mosaic following each belly roll, darker lacquer settling into each deep crease. Densely filled with no plain skin, covering the shoulders and arms completely down to the wrists and the legs down to the ankles.

Pose: Standing full frontal in a relaxed contrapposto with her feet planted apart, her weight on one leg so that huge hip juts outward, arms held away from the body, never covering the belly.

Footwear: Extremely high cinnabar-red platform stiletto mules. Nails: extra long almond, red with gold-leaf tips.

Background & Lighting: A seamless warm cream studio backdrop with no props, the background much lighter than her body, soft warm light from one side carving deep shadows between each belly roll, making the gold leaf and eggshell glint, bright highlights on every glossy curve. Extreme high-gloss lacquer finish. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
